```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
df <- read_csv(here("data/raw", "fraud_dataset_v2.csv"))
```
```{r}
id_col <- names(df)[1]
cols_eval <- names(df)[-1] # Todas menos la primera

# Etiquetar la 1ra y 2da aparición
df_pares <- df %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  mutate(.orden = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

t1 <- df_pares %>% filter(.orden == 1) %>% arrange(.data[[id_col]])
t2 <- df_pares %>% filter(.orden == 2) %>% arrange(.data[[id_col]])

# Cálculo vectorizado directo
pcts <- sapply(cols_eval, function(col) {
  v1 <- t1[[col]]
  v2 <- t2[[col]]
  mean((v1 == v2) | (is.na(v1) & is.na(v2)), na.rm = TRUE) * 100
})

resumen <- tibble(
  columna = names(pcts),
  pct_identico = pcts
) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_identico))

print(resumen, n = 30)
```
